mechanism_narrative: A rising CPIAUCSL (monthly year-over-year change) signals persistent inflation that increases real interest rates, compressing equity valuations and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with rising CPIAUCSL, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate exceeds 3.0%, it signals restrictive monetary policy that reduces corporate borrowing and consumer spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with FEDFUNDS > 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) signals broad-based demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 4.0%), rising labor market tightness increases wage pressures and inflation expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with UNRATE < 4.0%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) trend signals robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months with rising INDPRO, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When housing starts (HOUST) fall below 1150.0 thousand units, it signals weakening residential demand that reduces consumer confidence and spending, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months with HOUST < 1150.0, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS signals active monetary tightening to combat inflation, increasing real discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months where both CPIAUCSL and FEDFUNDS rise, or interaction term Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion (GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%), accelerating demand growth increases overheating risk and policy tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters with GDPC1 annual growth > 2.5%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.
